title: 第十一章 还有大事没办呢
content_zh:
任傲天对任天一的回答身为满意，不骄不躁，分寸把握极为到位，他并不认为任天一不想做少家主，如此说也只是谦辞，随即说道：“之前是为父对一儿关注不够，为父也想弥补对你的缺憾，只要为父能做到，一儿尽管要求就是。”

    任傲天对任天一的这个承诺，分量不可谓不轻，也足以证明任傲天对任天一的重视，不过以任天一的天赋，再重视也不为过，毕竟未开脉就能萃取六品药液的人，古今少有，天纵奇才。

    “可不是嘛，你父亲一直自责之前对你关注过少，你父亲还说，若是你那师尊能够有办法让你开脉，不管付出多大的代价他都愿意呢。”主母也在一旁帮腔道。

    “父亲母亲费心了！”任天一忙起身行礼。

    “最近星落城有不少家族有意和我任家结亲，若一儿看上哪家姑娘，就直说，让母亲为你张罗。”主母看了一眼红纱遮面的白婧，意味深长的说道。

    白婧闻言，身子不由一僵，她当然明白主母话语间的意思，以任天一如今的地位配哪家的掌上千斤都是绰绰有余，何况自己是白家的弃女，又身患绝症，同时还有这丑陋的面容，这也正是她的痛处，就算是任天一再取一位，她也不敢说什么，不过她也很期待任天一的反应。

    只见任天一微微一笑，摆摆手说道：“这方面就不用劳烦母亲了，儿子与婧儿感情甚好，能娶到婧儿是儿子的福分，有她一个，儿子就知足了。”

    对于任天一的回答，主母不免有些吃惊，因为白婧毕竟是名声在外，好在她也是见过场面的人，随即哈哈一笑说道：“如此甚好，只要一儿满意就好。”

    而坐在一旁的白婧，对任天一的回答也显得极为震惊，从成亲到现在，两人也是仅有夫妻之名，每每情到浓时，任天一都会一再的克制，虽然任天一给出的理由是她体质特殊，在练气境之前破身会增加她修炼的难度，但她总认为是他嫌弃自己容貌的一种托词。

    但此时当着长辈的面听到任天一郑重的回答，心中甚是开心，同时又多了一份压力，生怕任天一看错了自己的体质，自己辜负了任天一的这份深情。

    ……

    是夜，任天一又为白婧写出了一份心法，即《天凤心法》的练气篇。

    “婧儿，你的体质比较特殊，只要你参透了这部心法，不用任何丹药辅助，仅靠吐纳天地间的精华，就可以提升修为，而且你吐纳天地间精华是身体自主的一种能力。”
content_en:
Ren Aotian was satisfied with Ren Tianyi's answer. He was neither arrogant nor impetuous, and was very well-measured. He did not think that Ren Tianyi did not want to be the young head of the family, and it was just a modest comment. He then said: "Before, my father did not pay enough attention to my son. My father also wants to make up for my shortcomings towards you. As long as my father can do it, my son will do whatever I ask for."

    Ren Aotian's promise to Ren Tianyi is of great importance, and it is enough to prove that Ren Aotian attaches great importance to Ren Tianyi. However, given Ren Tianyi's talent, he cannot attach too much importance to it. After all, there are few people in ancient and modern times who can extract sixth-grade medicinal liquid without opening a pulse, and they are geniuses.

    "Isn't that right? Your father has always blamed himself for paying too little attention to you before. Your father also said that if your master could find a way to open your pulse, he would be willing to pay no matter what the price." The mistress also helped.

    "Father and mother, thank you for your trouble!" Ren Tian stood up and saluted.

    "Recently, many families in Xingluo City are interested in marrying my Ren family. If you like a girl from any family, just tell me and ask your mother to help you." The mistress glanced at Bai Jing, whose face was covered with red gauze, and said meaningfully.

    When Bai Jing heard this, she couldn't help but stiffen. Of course she understood the meaning of her mistress' words. Ren Tianyi's current status was more than enough for any family's palm. What's more, she was an abandoned daughter of the Bai family, and she was terminally ill. She also had this ugly face. This was her pain point. Even if Ren Tianyi chose another one, she didn't dare to say anything, but she was also looking forward to Ren Tianyi's reaction.

    Ren Tianyi smiled slightly, waved his hand and said, "There is no need to bother mother about this. My son and Jing'er have a very good relationship. It is his blessing to marry Jing'er. With her, my son will be content."

    The mistress could not help but be a little surprised at Ren Tianyi's answer, because Bai Jing was well-known after all. Fortunately, she was also someone who had seen the scene. Then she laughed and said: "That's very good, as long as I am satisfied for a moment."

    Bai Jing, who was sitting next to her, seemed extremely shocked by Ren Tianyi's answer. From the time they got married to now, the two of them were only known as husband and wife. Whenever the love was strong, Ren Tianyi would restrain herself again and again. Although Ren Tianyi gave the reason that she had a special constitution and that losing her virginity before the Qi training realm would make it more difficult for her to practice, she always thought it was an excuse for him to dislike her appearance.

    But at this time, hearing Ren Tianyi's solemn answer in front of the elders, I felt very happy, but at the same time I felt more pressure, fearing that Ren Tianyi had misjudged his physique and that he would let down Ren Tianyi's affection.

    …

    That night, Ren Tianyi wrote another mental method for Bai Jing, namely the qi training chapter of "Tianfeng Heart Method".

    "Jing'er, your physique is quite special. As long as you understand this mental method, you can improve your cultivation just by breathing in the essence of heaven and earth without the aid of any pills. Moreover, your ability to breathe in the essence of heaven and earth is an independent ability of your body."
title_en: Chapter 11 There are still big things to do
